oe_romp_is_roman_pagan = {

}

# Shared O(1) trigger: at least one of the 10 v9.8 Hexapantheon deities is seated.
oe_romp_has_any_new_god_seated = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno

		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
	}
}

	OR = {

	}
}

# Shared O(1) trigger: Capitoline Triad seated (Jupiter + Juno + Minerva).
oe_romp_has_capitoline_triad_seated = {
	has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_athena }
}

# Shared O(1) trigger: player BYZ/ROM eligible to proclaim Religio Romana via Mistra or Eternal City path.
oe_romp_can_proclaim_religio_romana = {
	is_ai = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
	}
	NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			OR = {
				owns = location:mystras
				owns = location:athens
			}
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_romp_ev2_done
				oe_ren_neo_leading = yes
				current_year >= 1415
			}
		}
		AND = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			owns = location:athens
			owns = location:rome
		}
	}
}
